milestones.title: Foundation & Core Finance
milestones.description: Core personal finance tracking, budgets, goals, debt management, and category organization.

milestones.title: NEPSE & Portfolio Platform
milestones.description: Full NEPSE stock market integration, crypto support, portfolio management, SIP plans, MeroShare automation, currency tools, Dropbox sync, and biometric security.

milestones.title: Automation & Extension Ecosystem
milestones.description: Remote browser automation, browser extension sync bridge, portfolio snapshots, and budget/goal UX refinements.

milestones.title: Storage & Sync Architecture
milestones.description: Migrate from localStorage to IndexedDB, record-level sync, UX overhaul, portfolio heatmap, insights advisor, and data integrity hardening.

milestones.title: AI & Insights Engine
milestones.description: Smart spending predictions, AI-powered budget suggestions, anomaly detection, natural language queries, and insights engine foundation.

items.title: Transaction Tracking & Categories
items.description: Record and categorize all income and expenses with custom categories, subcategories, and payment method support.

items.title: Budget Management System
items.description: Set monthly/weekly spending limits with subcategories, emergency reserves, and over-budget detection with real-time progress bars.

items.title: Goal Tracking & Hard Plan Challenges
items.description: Visual progress tracking with auto-contribution, gamified savings challenges, penalty tracking, and investment reward points.

items.title: Debt & Credit Management
items.description: Track loans, credit cards, fast debt accounts, and repayment plans with payment scheduling and interest calculations.

items.title: Financial Health Score & Insights
items.description: Comprehensive financial wellness scoring with spending trends, category performance analysis, and scenario planning.

items.title: PWA with Offline Support
items.description: Progressive Web App with service worker (Serwist), offline mode, push notifications, and install prompts across all platforms.

items.title: Receipt & QR Code Scanner
items.description: OCR-powered receipt scanning with Tesseract.js and QR code scanning for quick transaction data entry.

items.title: NEPSE Stock Market Integration
items.description: Real-time Nepali stock market data, company profiles, financial statements, sector analysis, and top stock rankings.

items.title: Portfolio Management
items.description: Multi-portfolio support for stocks and crypto with holdings tracking, P&L calculations, market snapshots, and IPO management.

items.title: SIP Plan Automation
items.description: Systematic Investment Plan automation with transaction enrollment, due date calculations, and carryover logic.

items.title: MeroShare IPO Automation
items.description: Automated IPO application through MeroShare with Puppeteer-based browser automation and DPS management.

items.title: Dropbox Cloud Backup & Sync
items.description: Secure OAuth2 PKCE-based Dropbox integration with selective import/export, tombstone sync, and token revocation.

items.title: Biometric Authentication & PIN Lock
items.description: WebAuthn-based fingerprint/face recognition, PIN management with secure key wrapping, and session timeout controls.

items.title: Floating Calculator & Productivity Tools
items.description: Multi-instance movable calculator with keyboard input, live results, docking, tabbed history, and currency converter.

items.title: Crypto Market Tracking
items.description: Crypto watch data, popular coin discovery, symbol resolution, and portfolio-ready pricing through the Coinlore integration.

items.title: Crypto Portfolio Tracking
items.description: Track crypto holdings inside portfolios with asset type support, crypto identifiers, units, valuation, and P&L alongside stock investments.

items.title: Currency Exchange & Converter
items.description: Built-in currency conversion flow for quick exchange calculations across wallet tools and financial workflows.

items.title: Coinlore Crypto API Integration
items.description: Server-side Coinlore proxy routes for popular coins, symbol resolution, and crypto price lookup without exposing client-side API assumptions.

items.title: Crypto News & Market Context
items.description: Crypto news endpoint support for BTC and market context so users can connect portfolio movements with broader crypto updates.

items.title: Currency Conversion API Route
items.description: Dedicated currency conversion API route for transforming amounts between currencies from the app instead of relying only on static symbols.

items.title: Custom Currency System
items.description: User currency preferences, custom currency symbols, localized money formatting, and consistent currency rendering across wallet modules.

items.title: Financial Tools Suite
items.description: Floating calculator, quick-action tools, amount inputs, currency-aware helpers, and productivity utilities for day-to-day financial decisions.

items.title: Shift Tracker & Timed Wallet
items.description: Track work shifts and translate expenses into work-hour equivalents for time-based financial awareness.

items.title: Browserless Remote MeroShare Automation
items.description: WebSocket-based Browserless integration for running MeroShare automation in cloud browsers without local Puppeteer.

items.title: Browser Extension Sync Bridge
items.description: Chrome/Firefox companion extension with bi-directional wallet state sync via a global extension bridge component.

items.title: Portfolio Price Histories & Snapshots
items.description: Grouped price history charts, valuation timeline modals, and snapshot views for portfolio performance analysis.

items.title: Budget Period Boundary Fix
items.description: Corrected monthly/weekly budget transaction counting to start from the 1st day of the active period with proper reset logic.

items.title: Goal Metrics & Challenge UI Overhaul
items.description: Streamlined goal cards with Key Metrics Grid, restored Hard Plan challenge points/penalties, and fixed history scroll modals.

items.title: 4-Digit Versioning System (2.1.0.0)
items.description: Transitioned from 3-digit semver to 4-digit versioning for better sub-release tracking across platforms.

items.title: Sell Quantity Validation & Trade Preview
items.description: Prevent overselling with remaining-units calculation, normalized trade type previews, and reinvestment toggles.

items.title: Migrate Core Data to IndexedDB
items.description: Move transactions, budgets, goals, portfolios, and debts from localStorage JSON blobs to structured IndexedDB stores with indexes.

items.title: Record-Level Sync Engine
items.description: Replace full-array saves with per-record writes. Add consistent createdAt/updatedAt/deletedAt timestamps for conflict resolution.

items.title: Deep Data Integrity Hashing
items.description: Fix shallow JSON.stringify hashing to properly validate nested financial fields and detect all mutations.

items.title: Secure Key Rotation with Re-Encryption
items.description: Fix rotateMasterKey() to re-encrypt all existing wallet records during key rotation instead of creating orphaned data.

items.title: Encrypted Token Storage
items.description: Move Dropbox access/refresh tokens from raw localStorage to encrypted storage to mitigate XSS token theft.

items.title: Dropbox Merge Conflict Improvements
items.description: Fix merge logic to use updatedAt timestamps instead of transaction dates, preventing newer changes from being overwritten.

items.title: Split Wallet Context by Domain
items.description: Break the monolithic WalletDataContext into domain-specific providers to reduce unnecessary rerenders across unrelated screens.

items.title: Storage Adapter Layer
items.description: Create an abstraction layer over localStorage/IndexedDB to enable transparent backend switching and consistent encryption.

items.title: Smart Spending Predictions
items.description: ML-powered spending pattern analysis to predict monthly expenses and suggest proactive budget adjustments.

items.title: Natural Language Financial Queries
items.description: Ask questions like 'How much did I spend on food last month?' and get instant answers from your wallet data.

items.title: Multi-Device Real-Time Sync
items.description: WebSocket or Server-Sent Events based real-time sync across multiple devices with conflict resolution.

items.title: Public Roadmap Page
items.description: Beautiful, searchable, filterable roadmap page with milestone tracking, progress visualization, and status indicators.

items.title: Version 2.1.1.0 Development Cycle
items.description: Active unreleased development cycle for the next MyWallet build. Release notes will stay on the last public version until 2.1.1.0 is shipped.

items.title: Insights Engine Stability & Hooks Compliance
items.description: Fixed React rules-of-hooks violations across Financial Health Score, Spending Trends, Category Dashboard, and Spending Benchmarks. Added Export Report functionality to Insights Panel.

items.title: Public Pages Suite
items.description: About page with story, stats, timeline, and creator profile. Features catalog showcasing 45+ capabilities. Shared public layout, glassmorphism nav, and full footer.

items.title: Settings Module Overhaul
items.description: Replaced monolithic modal with tabbed desktop layout and full-screen mobile settings. Custom theme editor with color picker. Audio feedback system with per-activity sounds and upload. Screen reader, accessibility controls, font size slider, and Nepali/International number formatting.

items.title: Portfolio Heatmap View
items.description: Treemap-based portfolio visualization with squarified layout algorithm. Search, asset/sizing/color mode filters, pin-to-detail, hover tooltip, and info dialog.

items.title: IPO Detail Modal with MeroShare Actions
items.description: Full IPO detail view with timeline, stats, and inline MeroShare apply/check allotment. Smart button adapts to IPO status; credential validation before actions.

items.title: Debt & Credit Management Redesign
items.description: Tabbed layout (Debt/Lending/Credit/History) with summary cards, collapsible accounts, payoff projections, fast debt auto-classification, and archive support. Transaction history dialog with custom date range picker.

items.title: Insights Smart Advisor & Financial Health
items.description: Financial health hero with score circle, grade, and description. Smart Advisor feed with 10 dynamic insight types, one-click auto-create actions, core metrics grid, and JSON export report.

items.title: Broker Leaderboard with Podium
items.description: Renamed from broker training. Hero podium section with crown/medal/award icons and animated columns. Daily sort option, rank badges, and BS-aware amount formatting.

items.title: Budget & Goal List Enhancements
items.description: Budget sort/filter/bulk operations with history dialog. Goal tabs layout with progress visualization and scenario planning. Custom date range pickers for both budget and goal history.

items.title: Balance Card Consolidation & Net Worth Carousel
items.description: Consolidated balance-card-component into balance-card.tsx. Added net worth carousel with swipe/touch support, income/expense monthly vs all-time toggle, and localStorage theme customization.

items.title: Personal Document Vault
items.description: Upload, store, view, and manage important personal documents (passports, IDs, contracts, certificates). Secure encrypted storage with per-document access control and expiry alerts.

items.title: Document Viewer & Preview
items.description: In-app viewer for uploaded documents with zoom, page navigation, and full-screen mode. Supports PDF, images, and common document formats with fast, native-like rendering.

items.title: Document Expiry & Renewal Reminders
items.description: Track passport, ID, license, and certificate expiry dates with push notifications and calendar alerts before renewal deadlines.
